d: Maharashtr Food and Drug Administration (FDA) ke kamishnar IAS tukaram mundhe aur bolivud ektar ajay devgan ke bich vimal ilaychi ke vigyapan ko lekar kanuni jang shuru ho gaee hai. FDA ka aarop hai ki ilaychi ke nam par pratibandhit pan masale ka prachar (Surrogate Advertising) kiya ja raha hai. notis ke bad ajay devgan ne bombe haeekort ka darvaja khatakhtaya aur FDA ki karravaee ko ektarpha bataya. unka kahna hai ki vigyapan sirph ilaychi ka tha, pan masale ka nahin. vahin tukaram mundhe ne saph kaha hai ki kanun ke aage koee star nahin hai aur karravaee jari rahegi. janie pura mamla.
